name: Replit Agent
tagline: AI agent that builds and deploys apps inside Replit
description: Replit Agent is an autonomous AI engineer that lives inside the Replit cloud IDE. Given a goal, it scaffolds a project, installs dependencies, writes the code, runs it, debugs issues, and deploys — all inside a Replit workspace with a live preview. It pairs well with Replit Database, Auth, and Deployments for end-to-end app delivery without leaving the browser.
pricingDetails: Included in Replit Core ($20/month) with monthly Agent credits. Teams: $40/user/month. Pay-as-you-go credits available.
